note: Triennial election of Londonderry Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. Waterside, Ardmore and Claudy were contested and the Unionists held all three against Independents; nine other divisions were filled unopposed at nomination on 19 May 1964 (Londonderry Sentinel, 20 May 1964, p. 1). The Dungiven and Faughanvale contests reported in the same articles were for Londonderry County Council. Glendermott added from the first meeting of the new council (meetings gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Printed 'Ballymullins'. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Ballymullan' to Ballymullins (13 Nov 2026, by the owner's rule for division spellings: the official or DED-map name where there is one, otherwise the spelling most rounds use): the DED maps of 1921-69 (BALLYMULLINS) spell it Ballymullins. This round was filed under the spelling 'Ballymullan', a form of the division's name it keeps as an alias; the old address (ballymullan) answers with a redirect to this one.
